author: nameless123456
quote: This is how you do a remake. The 2026 Switch 2 version of Ocarina of Time takes everything that made the original a masterpiece and polishes it with modern visuals and controls without losing its soul. The new art style is gorgeous, the dungeons are still brilliantly designed, and the quality-of-life improvements make revisiting Hyrule feel fresh and smooth.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: nameless123456
quote: 0/10. Overhyped beyond reason. The expectations are so ridiculously high that Rockstar has set itself up for disappointment. Marketing hype doesn't equal quality, and I refuse to give a free pass to a game just because of its name.
